name: Yuka Tiles
description: Yuka Tiles is a calm, photographic WordPress theme designed for tile and stone showrooms, material libraries, and surface merchants. Built with a card-mosaic archetype and clean sans-serif typography, it presents materials in natural daylight using flush photo ledgers, spec-sheet definition tables, and sample-borrowing workflows. Fully responsive and WooCommerce compatible, the theme features subtle parallax movement and a shrinking two-weight wordmark.
